body.purpose: Default text for descriptions, help, and dialog paragraphs.

mono.purpose: Gateway URLs in code elements; IDs and token inputs use system sans.

motion.name: dialog-appear
motion.purpose: Native dialog entrance animation, gated behind prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main action button for pairing and confirmation dialogs.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height:44px; padding:8px 16px; border:1px solid #235cc2; border-radius:6px; background:#235cc2; color:#fff; font-weight:600; font-size:13px; cursor:pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:color-mix(in srgb,#235cc2,#000 15%); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #235cc2; outline-offset:3px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity:.58; cursor:default; }

components.name: Default Button
components.description: Secondary actions, close buttons, and detail toggles.
components.css: .ds-btn-default { min-height:44px; padding:8px 16px; border:1px solid #d8dee7; border-radius:6px; background:#fff; color:#202a38; font-weight:600; font-size:13px; cursor:pointer; } .ds-btn-default:hover { background:#edf3ff; border-color:#235cc2; } .ds-btn-default:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #235cc2; outline-offset:3px; } .ds-btn-default:disabled { opacity:.58; cursor:default; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive confirmation only, such as revoking worker access.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { min-height:44px; padding:8px 16px; border:1px solid #a32630; border-radius:6px; background:#fff; color:#a32630; font-weight:600; font-size:13px; cursor:pointer; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background:#edf3ff; border-color:#235cc2; } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #235cc2; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Worker ID entry and readonly token/address display.
components.css: .ds-input { width:100%; min-height:44px; padding:12px; font-size:16px; color:#202a38; background:#fff; border:1px solid #d8dee7; border-radius:6px; caret-color:#235cc2; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #235cc2; outline-offset:3px; } .ds-input[readonly] { background:#f3f5f8; }

components.name: State Indicator
components.description: Inline status dot and label for worker connection state.
components.css: .ds-state { display:inline-flex; gap:6px; align-items:center; font-size:12px; font-weight:600; } .ds-state::before { content:""; width:6px; height:6px; border-radius:50%; background:currentColor; flex:none; } .ds-state-ok { color:#226346; } .ds-state-warn { color:#82561b; } .ds-state-off { color:#566474; }

narrative.overview:
A flat operator surface for three browser extensions. The design is a direct expression of shared KH conventions: system sans type, cool white/slate surfaces, one restrained blue accent, and honest states that never pretend to know what they do not. No imagery, no charts, no decorative form — just a list that shows what is connected, what it reports, and what needs attention.

Light mode is the desktop working default; dark mode follows prefers-color-scheme with its own complete palette. Every token comes from either the shared KH design-tokens.json (spacing, radii, type scale) or the connector's own app.css (colors). Nothing is invented.
keyCharacteristics: Flat list layout with expandable details in place
Shared KH spacing and radius scale, applied through scoped CSS custom properties
System font stack only; no web fonts
One blue accent for interactive elements; semantic colors for state only
Light and dark palettes are both first-class, not afterthoughts

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Gateway Blue is the only non-semantic color used for interaction. No second accent, no gradient, no decorative color. If something is clickable or focused, it uses this blue or its soft variant. Everything else is neutral or semantic.

rules.name: The System Type Rule
rules.body: All typography uses the platform's native font stack. No @font-face, no Google Fonts, no variable font axes. Sizes follow the shared token scale, with 16px form inputs for mobile usability.

dos: Do use the shared KH spacing scale for layout rhythm; fixed viewport safety margins and focus offsets remain literal in the implementation.
Do keep the connection list flat. Expandable details stay inline; never create a separate detail page or modal for worker information.
Do show unknown honestly. "Not reported", "Unknown", "Time unavailable" are valid display states. Never substitute zero, empty string, or a guessed value.
Do use semantic colors only for state. OK/warn/bad appear in state dots, error text, and danger buttons. They never decorate headers, backgrounds, or non-state elements.
donts: Don't add shadows, gradients, or decorative elevation. The surface is intentionally flat; depth comes from color contrast and borders.
Don't introduce a second accent color. Gateway Blue is the sole interactive color. Charts, illustrations, and multi-color encoding are out of scope.
Don't use web fonts or custom typefaces. The system font stack is a deliberate choice for native rendering quality and zero load cost.
Don't animate beyond the dialog entrance. No hover transitions, no loading spinners, no progress bars. Loading states use text and aria-busy.
Don't invent token values outside the shared scale. If a spacing or size need falls between existing steps, use the next larger step rather than creating an intermediate value.
